Entry Outsiders in the Riverlands How the Riverlands treat outsiders often says more about its character than official etiquette. Foreign armies regard this place as a passage, and local people know that every road will bring other people’s wars to their own door; trade routes, marriage alliances, and wars will constantly force this kind of judgment. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
